terms.gloss: it’s a wonder if … not: I bet …, most likely …
evidence: Ter. And. 598: Mīrum nī domī est.
Plaut. Amph. 319: Mīrum nī hic mē quasi mūrēnam exossāre cōgitat.
terms.comment: Lewis & Short s.v. mīrus: “it would be wonderful, I should wonder, I am very much mistaken, if not, i.e. most probably, undoubtedly”. Also mīrum nisi.

terms.gloss: I’d be surprised if … not (the same in the plural)
evidence: Plaut. Amph. 283: mīra sunt nisi invītāvit sēsē in cēnā plūsculum

phrases.latin: Mīrum nī hic mē quasi mūrēnam exossāre cōgitat.
phrases.english: I bet he means to bone me like an eel.

phrases.latin: mīra sunt nisi invītāvit sēsē in cēnā plūsculum
phrases.english: I’d be surprised if he didn’t do himself rather too well at dinner

sources: Lewis & Short: mirus
